primaryChecks.text: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.

context.text: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.
“‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.
